lemmas.primary_translation: to let something stand as what it is, without examining it more closely

definitions.text: la det gjelde for det det er, uten å gå nærmere inn på det
definitions.translation: let it stand as what it is, without examining it more closely (lit. let it stand at its value)

examples.no: andres arbeid får stå ved sitt verd når en ikke kan vurdere det
examples.en: Other people's work must be allowed to stand as it is when one cannot assess it
